description: This file defines a set of asynchronous functions for CRUD operations and listing on the 'projects' table in a database, representing the 'Project' data model in a crowdfunding platform backend.

methods.name: createProject({ owner_id, title, description, goal_amount, deadline, category })
methods.description: Inserts a new project record into the database and returns the created project data.

methods.name: getProjectById(id)
methods.description: Retrieves a project record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: listProjects({ q, category, owner_id, limit = 20, offset = 0 })
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects based on optional filters such as search query, category, owner, with pagination support.

methods.name: updateProject(id, owner_id, payload)
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing project if the owner matches, returns the updated project.

methods.name: deleteProject(id, owner_id)
methods.description: Deletes a project by ID if the owner matches, returns confirmation of deletion.

ctags.name: createProject
ctags.pattern: /^async function createProject({ owner_id, title, description, goal_amount, deadline, category }) /
ctags.signature: ({ owner_id, title, description, goal_amount, deadline, category })

ctags.name: listProjects
ctags.pattern: /^async function listProjects({ q, category, owner_id, limit = 20, offset = 0 }) {$/
